name: Hair lifts and settles
text: Her hair lifts and falls back against her shoulder.
desc: Life in an otherwise held shot. Motion that costs nothing dramatically.
needs: a person with loose hair in frame
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds, watched at subject crop. Motion 0.535/1.020/0.681. THE MOST DESTRUCTIVE CARD IN THE LIBRARY - subject survives 1/3. The hair does move on all three seeds, but on 7702 it lifts into a blonde-grey explosion and the face changes identity outright, and on 7703 she turns her back by f58. Only 7701 keeps a usable shot. Hair is texture attached to the performer, and asking for it destabilises the performer. Avoid on any beat where the face matters. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
